description:
Instant::now() panics on wasm32-unknown-unknown. The web-time crate is a drop-in std::time replacement using performance.now() on wasm and re-exporting std elsewhere.

Affected (measured file counts using Instant::now or SystemTime): tuas_boussinesq_solver 21, digital-twin-engine 13, dwsim-libs 3, tampines 2, chem-eng-control-simulator 2, teh-o-prke 1, tampines-steam-tables 1.

Mechanical import swap, not a redesign. Native behaviour must be bit-identical; that is testable and should be tested rather than assumed. GH #39 Phase 2.
title: Phase 2: swap std::time::Instant for web-time across the physics chain

description: Scaffolded 2026-07-10 (src/transport_corresponding_states.rs): CorrStatesModel enum {Chung, Ecs, RhosrCs} + corresponding_states_viscosity(fluid,t,rho)->Option<f64> stub (returns None). Closes the ~6-fluid viscosity gap (cyclopentane, isopentane, ethylbenzene, R1234yf, R1234ze(E), R152A) that currently return None. Remaining: implement Chung (1988), extended-corresponding-states (ECS), and rho*sr corresponding-states; then wire into transport::ViscosityModel + Fluid::transport().

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: PARTIALLY IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-10: Chung (1988) viscosity fully ported into transport.rs (ViscosityModel::Chung variant + chung_viscosity fn) and wired via dev/gen_fluid.py codegen for the 2 fluids CoolProp actually assigns Chung to (Cyclopentane, Isopentane -- confirmed by inspecting their JSON TRANSPORT.viscosity.type). Verified vs gas-phase viscosity ballpark (tests/chung_viscosity.rs). Investigated the other 4 fluids in the original 'Chung/ECS/rhosr-CS ~6 fluids' framing: EthylBenzene actually uses ECS (reference fluid = Propane), R1234yf/R1234ze(E) use rhosr-CS+ECS fallback, R152A uses rhosr-CS+None. ECS and rhosr-CS both need a reference-fluid's own transport surface -- materially larger scope than Chung, left as transport_corresponding_states.rs scaffold (todo!()). Remains open for ECS/rhosr-CS.

title: General corresponding-states transport (Chung/ECS/rhosr-CS)

description:
Cleanup surfaced 2026-08-14, separate from the (now settled) tier question in op-qui8.

The same paper exists twice:
  crates/kovan-literature/open/papers/choo-htr10-criticality.{json,pdf}          TRACKED, correct 2023 dating
  crates/kovan-literature/generated/markdown/proprietary/choo2024criticality.{md,json}   untracked
  crates/kovan-literature/generated/bibtex/proprietary/choo2024criticality.bib           untracked

The proprietary-tier copies carry the extractor's WRONG 2024 year, which CATALOGUE.md already records as an error corrected on 2026-08-11 ('The extractor's earlier guess of 2024 was wrong'). They are leftovers from before that correction and from before the tier was settled.

The tier is now decided (open, maintainer exception, recorded in the catalogue), so the proprietary-tier generated artifacts are stale duplicates under a wrong key. Regenerate the open-tier markdown/bibtex from the tracked JSON and delete the choo2024criticality.* set.

WATCH FOR: anything citing 'choo2024criticality' as a bib key. outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/htr10/neutronics.rs is already known to cite '(2024)' -- tracked in op-1lti -- so these two should probably be fixed together.
title: kovan-literature: choo2023criticality is duplicated across two tiers under two years

description: Issue #30 comment 2026-08-22 03:04/03:05 UTC. Two small regressions in already-shipped op-95x6/op-689u work: (1) the shared FileDialog is built with .default_file_filter("Images") once at DigitiseApp::default() time and never changed per-target, so clicking 'Open PDF...' in the PDF Reader still shows the Images filter selected -- fix by setting file_dialog.config_mut().default_file_filter dynamically (egui-file-dialog 0.13's pick_file() re-reads config.default_file_filter via set_default_file_filter() every call, confirmed by reading the vendored crate source) right before pick_file(), keyed off FileDialogTarget. (2) View::default() is View::Digitiser; maintainer wants PDF Reader as the default-open tab, i.e. View::default() -> View::PdfReader.
title: kovan-gui: PDF reader default tab + file-dialog filter defaults to the wrong type
